correctness.rationale: Any finite partial isomorphism extends by permuting untouched classes and extending the partial bijections inside the q-element classes. Over pointwise-named A, each old class is distinguishable, and up to its residual capacity there is one orbit for each subset of coordinate labels sent there. The remaining labels form a set of interchangeable nonempty blocks of sizes at most q. This gives the product of the truncated-exponential factors times the exponential for new classes. Dividing out the new-class factor and taking formal logarithms gives linear term sum_c a_c=t_1-1. Since log E_c=z-z^(c+1)/(c+1)!+O(z^(c+2)), degree k>=2 sees only capacities 1,...,k-1, with last diagonal coefficient -1/k!, so the first q-1 counts recover a_1,...,a_(q-2) and then a_(q-1) by subtraction. For q=2, the linear term is the entire inverse. Full classes have factor 1 and their number is recovered only given n through the mass identity n=q a_0+sum (q-c)a_c. The bases made of q singly occupied classes plus a full class, versus q doubly occupied classes, have 2q named points each; their capacity factors first differ at degree q-1, by q/(q-1)!, giving exactly q more ordered types in the first base. E_0=1 makes that argument valid at q=2, and the empty base gives just the new-class factor. The frozen checker and recorded outputs were inspected but not executed. Independent bounded computation python3 /workspace/independent_checks.py 2 checks capped partition signatures from actual marked block sizes for q=2,...,6, obtaining for q=3 (1,4,17) versus (1,4,14). The all-arity and all-q statements follow from the exact arguments, not enumeration.

value.rationale: It is natural to ask what orbit counts of the pointwise stabilizer remember about partial occupancy in a standard homogeneous finite cover. There is an exact recovery cutoff independent of the size of the base and no need to know that size; equality of all counts and their blindness to full classes are thereby characterized. The equal-size pair proves that supplying base size cannot improve the universal prefix bound. This is an exact inverse and obstruction, beyond the routine type-series factorization.
